name: Patch-up station
brief: MK-085 Patch-up station: the base's first-aid locker. Round 2, matched to the pick: a tall framed white locker with a glowing green plus on its face (lit = ready), a warm window showing the supplies, two pulled-out drawers of plasters and suit patches, and an amber help button. PG: it fixes scrapes and suit tears, nothing scary.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
Rebuilt against the Midjourney pick: chunky off-white modules held by dark bumper frames (bkit.module), warm orange windows (bkit.window), darker ground. Round 1 kept in round1/.
